                        \ wp lsb 0 means non-immediate, return -1

            ;

exit.src:
header-imm exit
: texit
    fineforoptimisation @i
    if
      prev @ h# 4000 xor
      dup h# e000 and
      if
        drop
      else
        prev _!
        exit
      then
    then

    inline: exit
;

ahead.src:
header-imm ahead
: tahead
    here h# 0000 w,     \ forward unconditional branch
;

if.src:
header-imm if
: tif
    here h# 2000 w,     \ forward conditional branch
;

then.src:
header-imm then     ( addr -- )
: tthen

    swap +!

again.src:
header-imm again
: tagain

;

until.src:

    _!

:noname

loop.src:

postpone.src:
header-imm postpone
:noname
    parse-name sfind
    dup 0= ?abort
    0< if

        ['] compile,

accept.src:
header accept
: accept
    tethered @i if d# 30 emit then

    >r d# 0  ( addr len R: maxlen )

    begin
        key    ( addr len key R: maxlen )

        d# 9 over= if drop d# 32 then
        d# 127 over= if drop d# 8 then

        dup d# 31 u>
        if
            over r@ u<
            if
                tethered @i 0= if dup emit then
                >r 2dup+ r@ swap c! 1+ r>
            then
        then

        d# 8 over= if >r delchar r> then

        d# 10 over= swap d# 13 = or
    until

    rdrop nip
    space
;

refill.src:
header refill
: refill
    tib dup d# 128 accept
    source!
    true

header evaluate
:noname

    interpret

header tasksel
: tasksel

: mulstep ( ud u1 -- ud u1 )
    DOUBLE DOUBLE

    d2*

    r> 2*
;

: divstep  \ ( y x z )

sameword.src:
: sameword ( c-addr u wp -- c-addr u wp flag )
    2dup cell+ c@ = if              \ lengths match?
        3rd 3rd 3rd                 \ 3dup
        d# 3 + >r                   \ R: word in dictionary
        bounds
        begin
            2dupxor
        while
            dup c@ r@ c@ i<> if
                2drop rdrop false ;

;

: digit? ( c -- u f )
   lower
   dup h# 39 > h# 100 and +
   dup h# 160 > h# 127 and - h# 30 -

xt-skip.src:
: xt-skip   ( addr1 n1 xt -- addr2 n2 ) \ gforth
    \ skip all characters satisfying xt ( c -- f )
    >r
    BEGIN
        over c@ r@ execute
        overand
    WHILE
        1/string
    REPEAT
    rdrop ;

    begin
        dup
    while

((doubleAlso)).src:
: ((doubleAlso))
    h# 0. 2swap
    [char] - consume1 signflag _!
    >number
    [char] . consume1 >r            \ 0 is single, -1 double
    nip ?abort                      \ any chars remain: abort
    signflag @i ?dneg               \ is negative
    r> ?dup and                     \ if single, remove high cell
;

opticompile,.src:
: opticompile,  \ Classic compilation gives no pathological cases.
  compile,       \ Cannot handle this in compile, as some of the pathological cases use compile, themselves.
  true fineforoptimisation _!
;

optiexecute.src:
: optiexecute   \ All pathological conditions are caused by immediate definitions.
  execute
  fineforoptimisation off
;

dispatch.src:
: dispatch
    jumptable
    jmp execute                 \      -1      0       non-immediate
    jmp doubleAlso              \      0       0       number
    jmp execute                 \      1       0       immediate

    jmp opticompile,            \      -1      2       non-immediate
    jmp doubleAlso,             \      0       2       number
    jmp optiexecute

sm/rem.src:
\ n2.
: sm/rem ( d1 n1 -- n2 n3 )
    2dup xor >r     \ combined sign, for quotient
    over >r         \ sign of dividend, for remainder
    abs >r dabs r>
    um/mod          ( remainder quotient )
    swap r> sgn     \ apply to remainder
    swap r> sgn     \ apply to quotient
;

fm/mod.src:
\ Adapted from hForth
: fm/mod ( d1 n1 -- n2 n3 )
    dup >r 2dup xor >r
    >r dabs r@ abs
    um/mod
    r> 0< if
        swap negate swap
    then
    r> 0< if
        negate         \ negative quotient
        over if
            r@ rot - swap 1-
        then
    then
    r> drop
;

case.src: constant case immediate  ( init count of ofs )

of.src:
: of  ( #of -- orig #of+1 / x -- )
    1+    ( count ofs )
    postpone over  postpone = ( copy and test case value)
    postpone if    ( add orig to control flow stack )
    postpone drop  ( discards case value if = )
    swap           ( bring count back now )
; immediate

endof.src:
: endof ( orig1 #of -- orig2 #of )
    >r   ( move off the stack in case the control-flow )
         ( stack is the data stack. )
    postpone else
    r>   ( we can bring count back now )
; immediate

endcase.src:
: endcase  ( orig1..orign #of -- )
    postpone drop  ( discard case value )
    begin
        dup
    while
        swap postpone then 1-
    repeat drop
; immediate

.xt.src:
: .xt ( xt -- ) \ print XT's address and name, if valid
    dup .x
    dup
    begin
        2 -
        dup c@ $20 <
    until
    \ confirm by looking up with FIND
    tuck      ( caddr xt caddr )
    find      ( caddr xt xt n | caddr xt caddr 0 )
    0<> and = if
        count type
    else
        drop  \ not valid, so discard
    then
;

see.src:
: see
    '
    48 bounds
    begin
        cr dup .x
        dup @
        dup .x
        6 spaces
        dup 0< if
            [char] $ emit
            32767 and .x
        else
            dup 8191 and 2*
            swap 13 rshift cells _ + @ execute
        then
        cell+
        2dup =
    until
    2drop
;

dump.src:
: dump
    ?dup
    if
        1- 4 rshift 1+
        0 do
            cr dup dup .x space space
            16 0 do
                dup c@ .x2 1+
            loop
            space swap
            16 0 do
                dup c@ dup bl 127 within invert if
                    drop [char] .
                then
                emit 1+
            loop
            drop
        loop
    then
    drop
;
